name: The Hustle
source:
Business simulation game of adult video maker. The job is to scout the city in search of future actresses and manage their careers: participation in contests, performance on TV, scandals and other events.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一款成人影片制作人的商业模拟游戏。你的工作是走遍城市寻找未来的女演员，并管理她们的事业：参加比赛、电视演出、丑闻以及其他事件。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndreview[/url]]
